task.description: Read design SS9 (lib/letflow/design/req172-wasm-host-api-write-path-and-parity-suite.md) in full -- it enumerates 5 non-ABI semantic differences between Lua and WASM: wall-clock-timeout abandonment (vs Lua's crash), a malformed-name arm, var:write/variable:write naming divergence, call_service's coarser (blanket vs per-service) capability granularity, and fail's structural difference (pdict-signal mechanism vs Lua's direct crash). Add explicit disclosure of all 5 to lib/letflow/engine/wasm/host_api.ex's moduledoc, each with its justification, matching the design's own wording closely enough to satisfy the 5 failing tests at test/letflow/engine/wasm/host_api_write_test.exs lines 754,763,771,779,788 -- read those 5 tests first to see exactly what substring/content each one checks for. Do not change any other file or any logic -- this is a moduledoc-content-only fix. Do not modify anything under lib/letflow/engine/lua/. Run mix test test/letflow/engine/wasm/ test/letflow/engine/lua/ and mix compile --warnings-as-errors yourself and quote real output confirming all 5 previously-failing tests now pass and nothing else regressed.
acceptance_criteria: any semantic difference between the Lua and WASM host APIs that is not purely ABI (string encoding, return shape) is enumerated explicitly in the moduledoc with its justification; the moduledoc states that WASM-12 limits differences to ABI, so an unlisted one means the requirement is unmet
